issues.description: Resource IDs are interpolated into URL paths without escaping, so IDs containing '/', '?', or '#' can route incorrectly or alter request semantics.
Boolean fields use bool(...) coercion, so values like 'false' become True and corrupt retry/idempotency behavior.
BatchItemResult.status and ReviewResult.verdict are not runtime-validated despite Literal type annotations.
Successful response bodies are trusted blindly, causing raw JSONDecodeError/KeyError/ValueError instead of typed client errors on malformed API responses.
Retry-After parsing only supports numeric seconds and ignores the standard HTTP-date form.
httpx transport and timeout exceptions are neither retried nor wrapped, so transient network failures bypass the client error model.
timeout, backoff_base, and backoff_cap are not validated, allowing invalid retry timing or negative sleep failures.
Scripted mock responses bypass API-key validation, which can mask authentication regressions in tests.
The mock server assumes decoded JSON bodies are objects and can raise AttributeError instead of returning a 400 for JSON arrays/nulls.
Development tooling only includes pytest, with no checked-in linting, formatting, type checking, or coverage command for maintaining quality.
